parts.tooltip: fmap f :: List a ⟶ List (List b)\nmap f [a1, a2, a3]  =  [f a1, f a2, f a3]\nOne inner list per element; the outer structure is kept.
join :: List (List b) ⟶ List b — the List-specific part\nconcat [[b1, b2], [], [b3]]  =  [b1, b2, b3]\nInner lists are concatenated in order.

ports.tooltip: List a — zero or more possible values. An empty list short-circuits (no elements to process).
f : a ⟶ List b — user code; each call may return zero, one, or many results
List b — all branches expanded and flattened into a single list; never List (List b)
